name: What is the process for planning a home addition with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning a home addition with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your existing home. We then move to conceptual design, collaborating with architects if needed, followed by detailed architectural and engineering plans. Once designs are finalized, we assist with permit applications, navigating the specific requirements of municipalities like Oakland or Alameda. A key step before construction begins is ensuring all necessary plans are approved by the relevant local authorities, which we manage on your behalf.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, conceptual design, detailed plans, and assisting with permit applications, managing approvals before construction.
